description: This header file declares functions for parsing WebRTC session descriptions, ICE candidates, and error messages from JSON, as well as generating ICE server configuration messages. It is part of the WebRTC streaming utilities within the cuttlefish project.

methods.name: ParseSessionDescription
methods.description: Parses a WebRTC session description from a JSON message, returning a unique pointer to a SessionDescriptionInterface wrapped in a Result.

methods.name: ParseIceCandidate
methods.description: Parses an ICE candidate from a JSON message, returning a unique pointer to an IceCandidateInterface wrapped in a Result.

methods.name: ParseError
methods.description: Parses a JSON error message and returns it as a string wrapped in a Result.

methods.name: ParseIceServersMessage
methods.description: Checks for and parses the 'ice_servers' array in a JSON message into a vector of ICE server configurations.

methods.name: GenerateIceServersMessage
methods.description: Generates a JSON message representing a list of ICE servers.
